title: Detection-frontier code and data: uninformative non-reproduction in small cancer cohorts
description: Analysis code, derived result tables and figure source data for the manuscript 'Uninformative non-reproduction: a pre-computable power frontier explains which driver-phenotype associations small cancer cohorts can and cannot test'. Contains the closed-form power-surface derivation, a simulation validation across three non-normal data-generating regimes, and the applied driver-by-phenotype scan in TCGA malignant pleural mesothelioma. Every value in results/ is regenerated by the included scripts; the simulation uses CRC32-derived seeds so the grid reproduces bit-identically.
